//: Copy to deploy.<environment>.json and fill in. Those copies are gitignored because they carry credentials. Every key below is required unless marked optional.
//resourceGroup: Configuration rather than a constant, so an environment in another region can be added without reworking naming.
//appServicePlan: Shared deliberately: the dashboard API and every environment's Function App run on one plan. Not derived per environment.
//names: Optional. Omit or null to derive from the environment. Set only for resources that do not follow the pattern.
//secrets: Never commit these. This file is the reason deploy.*.json is gitignored.
//dashboard: The dashboard is shared across non-production environments. Exactly one environment should set hostsDashboard true; api and frontend are refused against the others.
//entra: One registration applied to both the SPA build and the API. Mixing two is what broke login before.
//function: Timer schedules must be present. A timer trigger whose schedule setting is missing fails to bind and takes the whole host down.
